Anaguta Love and Culture — Then & Now

By Anaguta Tradomodern Media

A visual and oral history project documenting the evolution of Anaguta customs across generations.

About the Project

This project captures interviews, archival photographs, and stories from elders to preserve the identity of the Anaguta people for future generations, looking at courtship, marriage rites, and community solidarity then and now.
